name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.1.0.

Recording a payment now works every time - entering a payment by hand on the Payments tab no longer says "Could not save".

Tally is safe if you open it AFTER ASVA: ASVA waits for Tally to finish loading before reading it, so it no longer makes Tally close with a memory error.

Your work is never wiped by a background sync - ticking parties for reminders or typing in the search box is no longer lost when the 5-minute Tally sync runs.

Payments received in Tally now show correctly on the customer page (latest first), and a new "Name A to Z (owing only)" filter shows just who owes you.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
